ud7.7:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā attano papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpahānaṃ paccavekkhamāno nisinno hoti.
ud7.7:2.1: atha kho bhagavā attano papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpahānaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud7.7:3.1: yassa papañcā ṭhiti ca n' atthi, {sandānaṃ} palighañ ca vītivatto, taṃ nittaṇhaṃ muniṃ carantaṃ n' āvajānāti sadevako pi loko. ||7||
